GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Hooked Out Five Wide rounding turn, moved into 5th place in Straight while giving up about a half length only to the winner # slowly away

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 12 Lengths Two Wide , hooked 3 Wide at 700m and Moved Up to 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked back across to rail at 150m and Held Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey's comments noted.] # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1000m shifted out to avoid heels. Rounding the home turn was eased when close to heels. Laid in before shifting in to the inside running rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths turning, shifted Two Wide at 450m, blocked 400m, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up , Made Some Ground in Straight # never a threat

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a head, went clear 1400m, led out and crossed to fence, Held Together middle stages, led rail by 0.75 Lengths turning, joined Straightening Up , not headed until 75m from post, kept battling to line # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight and leaving the 150m bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn and Lost Ground in Straight # never a threat
Bit Slow Out Restrained Straight Out The Back Inside 7 Lengths off Inside x 500 5 Lengths out 7 Wide Soon After Straightening Up with winner @ 200m, Kept Trying but # not quick enough
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 11 Lengths on fence, worked up to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept coming in Straight # battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Brushed leaving the 200m and near the 100m. Bumped heavily near the 20m and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down 8th Inside 6-7 Lengths off Inside 500m Ridden Along couldn't quicken - # Could Not Keep Up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported filly may not have appreciated track conditions and would derive fitness benefit from event. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 1/2 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 7 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist, locked away nowhere to go until the 400 quickened @ 300 ducked and weaved, into 3rd Near line, was $201.00 but # ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly and lost ground. Near the 150m was obliged to alter course and shift out to improve into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then Checked at 200m, Lost Ground to the line. (Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # Had some excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Held up for clear running approaching the 400m and again approaching the 300m. Tightened for room and obliged to check approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing the start and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4.5 Lengths turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it may not have appreciated the step-up in distance and the softer track.] # slow out/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When asked about performance, Rdr stated filly may not have appreciated the step up in distance and softer track conditions.
